notes: No Extron SKU named "DMP 128 Plus C V2" exists in the current catalog — Extron's actual model-suffix system is C (adds 12-channel AEC + noise cancellation), V (adds VoIP/SIP with a second LAN port), and AT (adds 4-port Dante/AES-67 switch), combinable as C, C AT, C V, C V AT. This device is built as the "DMP 128 Plus C V" (AEC + VoIP, no Dante), the closest real match to "C V2"; the "2" most likely colloquially refers to its two LAN/VoIP RJ-45 ports (LAN1 default 192.168.254.254, LAN2/VoIP default 192.168.1.254) rather than a distinct hardware revision. If a genuine "V2" hardware-revision or Dante ("AT") variant was intended, port counts for AT models differ (adds 4x RJ-45 Dante ports; AT models also list 48ch Rx/24ch Tx digital audio). Sources: official Extron spec sheet (mirrored via dekom.com, matches extron.com/download/files/specs/DMP_128_PLUS_5809-D8.pdf which was blocked by direct fetch) and the official Extron Setup Guide PDF (media.extron.com/public/download/files/userman/68-2826-50_C.pdf) which diagrams the fully-featured C V AT rear panel and calls out per-model differences explicitly (LAN port count, AEC on C models only, AT ports on AT models only). Mic inputs 9-12 use two 6-pole 3.5mm connectors (2 channels/connector); line outputs 1-8 use four 6-pole 3.5mm connectors (2 channels/connector) — modeled here as one representative port entry per connector pair per the spec's connector count, with names reflecting the input/output numbers each physical jack serves. Front-panel USB mini-B is a configuration-only port (no host audio) separate from the rear-panel USB Audio port. Digital I/O pins are software-programmable input/output logic (not audio) at 0-12V logic levels, closest connector modeled as euroblock (4-pole 3.5mm captive screw, not audio signal). RS-232 and ACP ports are also 3.5mm captive screw euroblock-style connectors, not literal DB9/panel connectors. All connector types are 3.5mm captive-screw euroblock terminal blocks (Extron's standard for this product line), not molded audio jacks.
